item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find high-confidence 2024 reporting that directly proves Erdoğan personally took bribes or engaged in clearly documented private self-dealing. The best evidence for that part of the lens is indirect: a broader environment of impunity, patronage, media manipulation, and opaque state power. I did not count unadjudicated allegations as accepted evidence.","evidence":[{"title":"Self-critique after local-election losses","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-04-01","url":"https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/turkeys-erdogan-says-party-to-self-critique-after-local-election-losses","summary":"Claim: Erdoğan said the ruling alliance did not get the desired result and would carry out self-criticism and address shortcomings after the local-election defeat. This is limited positive evidence of public acknowledgment rather than flat denial.","question_ids":["7B.10"]},{"title":"Technocrat appointed to central bank","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-02-02","url":"https://finance.yahoo.com/news/1-erdogan-appointed-fatih-karahan-215022059.html","summary":"Claim: Erdoğan replaced the outgoing central-bank governor with Fatih Karahan, a professional economist with Fed and academic credentials. This is weak-to-moderate positive evidence that at least one major state post was filled on competence grounds rather than obvious patronage.","question_ids":["7B.10"]},{"title":"Rule-based procurement lane","publisher":"Devlet Malzeme Ofisi Genel Müdürlüğü","date":"2024-05-03","url":"https://www.dmo.gov.tr/Eng/Home/EngIcerik/1212","summary":"Claim: DMO said its central purchasing system emphasizes transparency, competition, accountability, and digital e-tenders, including hospital drug and medical-supply procurement. This is a concrete counterexample to a blanket “everything is patronage” reading.","question_ids":["7B.10"]},{"title":"AML/CFT progress and anti-corruption framing","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-10-11","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/10/11/republic-of-trkiye-2024-article-iv-consultation-press-release-staff-report-and-statement-by-556139","summary":"Claim: The IMF said Türkiye made improvements in AML/CFT and that authorities were preparing a new anti-corruption strategy. This is modest positive evidence for integrity-building capacity, though it is institutional rather than a personal ethics signal.","question_ids":["7B.10"]},{"title":"Exit from FATF grey list","publisher":"FATF","date":"2024-06-28","url":"https://www.fatf-gafi.org/en/publications/High-risk-and-other-monitored-jurisdictions/increased-monitoring-june-2024.html","summary":"Claim: FATF welcomed Türkiye’s significant progress on AML/CFT, including beneficial-ownership supervision, sanctions, and financial-intelligence use, and removed it from increased monitoring. It also says Erdoğan and the AKP used state power, media favoritism, and distorted messaging during the campaign. This is strong negative evidence for 7B.10.","question_ids":["7B.10"]},{"title":"Media control and manipulated public information","publisher":"Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism","date":"2024-06-17","url":"https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/turkey","summary":"Claim: The report says Erdoğan entered the new term with continued tight media control, and progovernment outlets plus TRT gave disproportionate airtime to incumbents while RTÜK fined critical channels. This supports the view that public trust was being managed rather than earned.","question_ids":["7B.10"]},{"title":"Opaque property action in Hatay","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-03-18","url":"https://www.reuters.com/commodities/shock-confusion-as-turkey-seizes-earthquake-survivors-homes-2024-03-18/","summary":"Claim: Thousands of earthquake survivors were blindsided when property deeds were transferred to the Treasury under an urban-planning amendment, with unclear compensation. This is strong negative evidence on transparency and trust in state action.","question_ids":["7B.10"]},{"title":"Neutralizing opposition local power","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-11-07","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/11/07/turkiye-government-removes-elected-opposition-mayors","summary":"Claim: HRW said elected opposition mayors were removed, councils dissolved, and trustees/appointees installed using terrorism allegations. This is strong evidence of coercive, politically selective governance that undercuts ethical standards and public trust.","question_ids":["7B.10"]}]}
